content:
**Cappy's Nuka-Cade** is an unmarked location in *Fallout 76*, introduced in the *Nuka-World on Tour* update.

Cappy's Nuka-Cade sits beside the main crafting hub in the center of Nuka-World On Tour. The Vault Dwellers can play several minigames here in order to earn points to redeem at the terminals available inside the Nuka-Cade. Bruno the Strongbot walks around the inside of the arcade. To the right of the entrance, Lady G's booth can be found. Chloe the Clown can be found floating around the outside of the Nuka-Cade. Cappy's Nuka-Cade is shaped like a giant tipped over bottle.

On the left near the entrance, sits two prize terminals where Vault Dwellers can redeem their points earned from any of the Nuka-World On Tour themed Public Events, as well as points earned in the Nuka-Cade. Across from the terminals, on the right side of the entrance there are a few Bottle Blaster and Whac-a-Commie machines.

In the back of the arcade there are some Bandit Roundup and Nuka-Zapper Race machines. To play any of the games, the Vault Dweller must insert tokens to start. 1 token is equal to 1 Cap. Based on performance in any of the games, the Vault Dweller will receive Nuka-Cade points as a reward.
